sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/346 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 346, search/grid facilities 415 'Area 1', 416 'Area 2', 417 Group/Equestrian for 2027-06-15 and 2027-01-12, search/details for all web-listed units on 2027-06-15, plus one site of each type on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12 and 2027-06-19, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Electric sites $39 a night, full hookups $52, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) both are $35. The five primitive equestrian sites are $23. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Deer Creek units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 39.00, Campsite Full Hookup 52.00, Campsite Equestrian Non-Electric 23.00, Fee 6.50); sites 001 and 013 on Sat 2027-06-19 (52.00 / 39.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (35.00 / 35.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '20/30/50' or '50' on all 224 RV sites; Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes' on the 30 full-hookup sites) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/deer-creek-state-park-campground ('202 Electric sites and 30 Full-Hookup sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 224 web-bookable RV sites in Areas 1 and 2 (194 electric, 30 full hookup), rated for camping units to 45 ft; one full-hookup site is a pull-through, the rest back-in. Shady and sunny; pets permitted on all sites. ODNR counts 202 electric + 30 full hookup.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (facilities 415 and 416, all AllowWebBooking) + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In' / one 'Pull Through', Maximum Camping Unit Length 45 on 225 units) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/deer-creek-state-park-campground ('202 Electric sites and 30 Full-Hookup sites, both shady and sunny. Pets are permitted on all sites.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Seasonal camp store; bicycles for rent at the camp office; mini golf, courts and two playgrounds. Off-peak wash houses 2 and 3 stay open with exterior water spigots for fill-up.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/deer-creek-state-park-campground ('A seasonal camp store is available'; 'Showers, flush toilets, laundry facilities, and dump station'; 'Off-Peak Season: Wash house 2 & 3 open with spigots on the exterior for water fill-up. Dump Station open.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak: wash houses 2 and 3 open; full-hookup sites have sewer but no water.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/deer-creek-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak Season: Wash house 2 & 3 open ... Sewer, but no water at full hookup sites.') + ReserveOhio search/grid 2027-01-12 (Area 1: 134 of 134 free; Area 2: 90 free), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations required, up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. Every listed site is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/deer-creek-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30
